sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.27733 Of 2021
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue writ or direction preferably writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in not paying compensation, interest on solatium and additional market value as per Section 80 of new Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for the land to an extent of Ac.5.00 guntas in Sy.No.52, situated at Singapur Village, Naspur Mandal of Mancherial District which was acquired for conversion of SRP-2 and 2-A Mines into opencast Mine and raising of Plantation and to develop Greenery as illegal, arbitrary and violative of principles of natural justice and consequently direct the respondents to finalize the issue for payment of compensation as per New Land Acquisition Act,
2013 and pay the compensation amount to the petitioners and pass..."

2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, learned Standing Counsel for Singareni Collieries and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.
SK,J 3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners brought to the notice of this Court that the respondent No.2 issued letter in Rc.No.C2/337/2020, dated 10.02.2020 directing the respondent No.3 to go through the contents of the petition filed by the petitioners dated 01.02.2020 and conduct detailed enquiry and submit report immediately.

In spite of the said orders of the respondent No.2, the respondent No.3 has not taken any action and the petitioners also filed another representation on 29.08.2020.
4.

In view of the submissions made by the both sides, without going into the merits of the case, the writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondent No.3 to consider the representation filed by the petitioners dated 01.02.2020 as per the letter of the respondent No.2 dated 10.02.2020 and also representation of the petitioners dated 29.08.2020 by giving opportunity to the petitioners SK,J in enquiry in accordance with law within eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and communicate the same to the petitioners.
There shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

JUSTICE K.SARATH Date: 12.06.2024 BB/DSV Smt.Atkapuram Narsu And Another vs State Of Telangana And 4 Others on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103127407/
